title: Ferric Chloride
description: Industrial ferric chloride for wastewater treatment and etching.

details.longDescription: Ferric Chloride supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides industrial ferric chloride for wastewater treatment, metal etching, and industrial applications in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our ferric chloride solution (40%) is a powerful coagulant for treating industrial wastewater, municipal sewage, and water clarification. Essential for removing phosphorus, heavy metals, and suspended solids from wastewater. The acidic coagulant works effectively across wide pH ranges. Widely used in sewage treatment plants, industrial effluent treatment, PCB manufacturing, and metal surface treatment across Oman. Also serves in pigment production, textile printing, and as a catalyst in organic synthesis. Ferric chloride (solid, anhydrous or hexahydrate) is a powerful coagulant and oxidising agent used in Oman's water treatment, electronics, and industrial sectors. As a wastewater coagulant, solid FeCl₃ is dissolved to prepare the 40% liquid solution used for phosphorus removal and flocculation in municipal and industrial wastewater treatment. In Oman's electronics and PCB manufacturing sector, ferric chloride solution is the etchant for copper etching in printed circuit board fabrication. In Oman's growing metal treatment industry, ferric chloride is used for blackening/passivation of steel. Global Chemicals LLC supplies ferric chloride in solid hexahydrate (FeCl₃·6H₂O) and anhydrous forms in 25kg bags and 1,000kg big bags, as well as pre-dissolved 40% liquid in IBC containers. SDS, CoA, and handling guidance provided.

title: Quicklime (Calcium Oxide)
description: Industrial quicklime for pH adjustment, water treatment, and manufacturing.

details.longDescription: Quicklime (Calcium Oxide) supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides industrial quicklime for water treatment, pH adjustment, and manufacturing processes in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our high-calcium quicklime is produced by calcining limestone and offers powerful alkalinity for neutralization applications. Essential for pH adjustment in wastewater treatment, water softening, and industrial neutralization processes. The highly reactive material generates heat upon contact with water (exothermic slaking). Widely used in steel production, construction, soil stabilization, and chemical manufacturing across Oman. Available in lump and powder forms to meet various industrial requirements. Quicklime (calcium oxide, CaO, 90%+ purity) is a fundamental industrial chemical in Oman's water treatment, construction, and mining sectors. In water treatment, quicklime is slaked (reacted with water) to produce hydrated lime (Ca(OH)₂) for pH adjustment, water softening, and heavy metal precipitation. In Oman's construction industry, lime is a key binder component in mortars, plasters, and soil stabilisation — widely used in road and infrastructure construction projects across Oman's interior highways and NEOM-adjacent developments. In environmental remediation, quicklime is applied for soil stabilisation and heavy metal immobilisation. In Oman's growing aggregates and quarrying sector, calcination of limestone to quicklime is produced at Raysut Industrial Area. Global Chemicals LLC supplies quicklime in 25kg bags and bulk for water treatment, construction, and industrial customers across Oman.
technicalSpecs: Available in 25kg bags, bulk bags, bulk

title: Sodium Silicate Solution (Water Glass)
description: Industrial sodium silicate for detergents, adhesives, and manufacturing.

details.longDescription: Sodium Silicate Solution supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides industrial water glass for detergents, adhesives, and manufacturing applications in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our sodium silicate solution (various ratios) offers excellent binding, adhesive, and detergency properties. Essential for detergent formulation, cement and concrete additives, adhesives, and refractory applications. The alkaline solution also serves as a deflocculant, binder, and corrosion inhibitor. Widely used in soap and detergent manufacturing, foundry operations, construction, and industrial cleaning across Oman. Available in various SiO2:Na2O ratios (2.0, 2.4, 3.22, 3.75) and concentrations to meet specific application requirements. Sodium silicate solution (waterglass, Na₂SiO₃ solution, SiO₂:Na₂O ratio 2.0–3.3) is a versatile industrial chemical used across Oman's construction, water treatment, and industrial sectors. In concrete and masonry waterproofing (a critical application in Oman's coastal construction projects where marine salinity and humidity drive moisture ingress), sodium silicate solution penetrates concrete pores and reacts with calcium hydroxide to form insoluble calcium silicate, sealing the structure. In Oman's water distribution networks, sodium silicate is applied as a pipe lining agent (internal pipe coating) to prevent iron dissolution and corrosion product contamination of drinking water. In detergent manufacturing, sodium silicate is used as an alkaline builder and corrosion inhibitor. Global Chemicals LLC supplies sodium silicate solution in drums and IBC containers. Ratio and density specifications available.
technicalSpecs: Viscosity: Varies by ratio and concentration

title: Zinc Sulfate
description: Industrial zinc sulfate for agriculture, water treatment, and manufacturing.

details.longDescription: Zinc Sulfate supplier in Oman - Global Chemicals LLC provides industrial and agricultural-grade zinc sulfate for fertilizers, animal nutrition, and industrial applications in Muscat, Sohar, Duqm, Salalah, Rusayl Industrial Area. Our zinc sulfate heptahydrate (21% Zn) is an essential micronutrient for crop production and animal feed supplement. Critical for preventing zinc deficiency in crops, improving yield, and quality. Also used in industrial applications including rayon manufacture, wood preservation, and as a mordant in dyeing. Widely used in agriculture, animal feed production, textile industries, and chemical manufacturing across Oman. Available in granular and powder forms for various applications. Zinc sulphate (ZnSO₄·7H₂O, heptahydrate, or ZnSO₄·H₂O monohydrate) has dual demand in Oman from the agricultural and water treatment sectors. In agriculture — a growing priority under Oman Vision 2040's food security programme — zinc sulphate is the most widely applied micronutrient fertiliser in Oman. Zinc deficiency is endemic in Oman's arid soils, particularly affecting date palm, citrus, mango, vegetables, and wheat crops. Foliar and soil application of zinc sulphate corrects deficiency and dramatically improves crop yields. In water treatment, zinc sulphate is used in low concentrations as a corrosion inhibitor for iron and steel pipelines — the zinc ion forms a protective film at the anodic sites. Global Chemicals LLC supplies zinc sulphate monohydrate (33% Zn) and heptahydrate (22% Zn) in 25kg bags for agricultural and industrial customers across Oman.
technicalSpecs: Available in 25kg bags, 50kg bags, bulk bags
